component: MailNews native include and macro boundaries

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned patch appends 29 MIME_SUPERCLASS and two MAPI_STARTUP_ARG undef directives. Several MIME files replace hand-written base-typed extern declarations with actual class headers. Related and Alternative headers declare their own concrete class types. Accepted multipart source retains those includes and the file-end undef; another changed historical file, mimeebod.cpp, no longer exists there. The finding is limited to these compilation boundaries and does not require clearing unrelated macros or prove a successful build.
title: MIME and MAPI file boundaries clear their local macros and use typed headers
